translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Wahyu
book.title: WAHYU Men ia Piile' I Yohanes

content: Mian na surugaa beleskon Babel men nokobaraba'ianmo
Noko daa iya'a, yaku' nongorongormo isian na surugaa wurung boolak koi wurungna mian biai' tuu' taena,

content.text: “Haleluya! Tunde' a Alaata'ala! Alaata'ala a men mansalamatkon, Ia men balaki' ka' kuasaan.
Kana' ka' maloos a pungukumi-Na, ka' i Ia a men nungukummo wiwine men bukuan mogora' iya'a men nanggau'kon mian na tano' balaki' sida nangawawau men ba'idek.
Alaata'ala a nungukum wiwine men bukuan mogora' iya'a, gause i ia nampapatei papalimang-Na.”

content: Kasi men koi wurungna mian biai' iya'a nokamporongoran soosoodo taena,

content.text: “Haleluya! Tunde' a Alaata'ala! Tibukna apu men muntunu kota balaki' iya'a sianta kokabu-kabusanna!”

content: Mbaka' ruampulo' ka' papaat tanaas ka' papaat siinsiing men isian na tiku-tikumna oruangan kobalaki'an iya'a nobanintuurmo ka' notumutuku' rumbuk tano' kasi nonsoosa' Alaata'ala men no'umoruang na oruangan kobalaki'an. Raaya'a norobu taena,
Kasi nokamporongoran a wurung men ringkat na oruangan kobalaki'an mangaan taena,

content.text: “Tunde' a Alaata'alanta i kuu giigii' papalimang-Na.
Kuu men morio' kabai se' moola' men layaonkon Alaata'ala, tunde' i Ia!”

content: Ramean posuo'anna Anak Dombana Alaata'ala
Noko daa koiya'a yaku' nongorongormo soosoodo isian koi wurungna mian biai' tuu' men mangkakaro'. Wurung iya'a, boolak tuu' koi rimbausna bokol ka' koi kokurung boolak, taena,

content.text: “Haleluya! Tunde' a Alaata'ala, gause Tumpu Alaata'alanta men kuasaan tuu' nosidamo Tomundo'!
Mai kita balewa-lewa' ka' muntunde' kobalaki'an-Na,
gause takamo a iliona posuo'anna Anak Domba, ka' wiwine-Na noko toropotmo.
Ia nitaraimo toik lenang men molusa' ka' dingkalapan bo pakeon.”
(Toik lenang iya'a mase giigii' wawau pore men ia limangmo mianna Alaata'ala.)

content: Kasi malaa'ikat iya'a norobu na ingku' taena, “Tulis ini'i! Barakaatan a mian men nileelo' na ramean posuo'anna Anak Domba iya'a.” Kasi taena soosoodo na ingku', “Wurung kani'i tuutuu' wurungna Alaata'ala.”

Mbaka' yaku' nobanintuurmo ka' notumutuku' rumbuk tano' beebeel saratna malaa'ikat iya'a bo monsoosa' i ia, kasee i ia norobu na ingku' taena, “Alia! Alia monsoosa' i yaku'! Soosa' a Alaata'ala, gause yaku' uga' papalimangna Tumpu koikoimo tii koo ka' koikoimo tia utuus sa'angu' kaparasaya'an men mompotuutuu' i Yesus. Gause nompotuutuu'an i Yesus iya'a a men minsidakon mian mamaka'ala mengelelekon lele men ringkat na Alaata'ala.”
Yesusmo a Wurungna Alaata'ala
Kasi yaku' nimiile' surugaa nokobongkatian. Inda'a isian sa'angu' kuda bubulak, ka' men nangalakiti ngaanna i “Malolo' ka' Kana'.” Maloos a pungukumi-Na tia poopapate-Na.
Mata-Na koi leapna apu ka' na takala'-Na nosongko' biai' songko'na tomundo'. Na waka-Na nitulisii ngaan kasee ngaan iya'a tongko' i Ia suungna a ninginti'i.
Ia nojuba men niromokmo na rara'. Ka' men nojuba iya'a ngaan-Na i “Wurungna Alaata'ala.”
Ka' giigii' men poopapate na surugaa nongololo' i Ia. Raaya'a poto lakit na kuda bubulak ka' nopake toik lenang men bubulak moloe'.

Na nganga'-Na ua'uar a sa'angu' sinangkidi men masasom. Sinangkidimo iya'a a men bo pungurungku'i-Na giigii' lipu', ka' i Ia bo mamarenta i raaya'a tia noa mapanas. Alaata'ala men kuasaan tuu' bo mimpipiile'kon maso'-Na men mosua-suap. Maso'-Na iya'a dodoa tuu' koi mimiis anggur na piisanna.
Na juba-Na ka' na pa'a-Na nitulisii, Tomundo' na giigii' tomundo', Tanaas na giigii' tanaas.
Ayop tia minti nabi-nabii nirungku'i

Kasi yaku' nimiile' sa'angu' malaa'ikat na wawona matana ilio. Boolak a wurungna mengeleelo' giigii' sapu' men poto layang na lealaa taena, “Mai barimpung ka'ita kada' mongololo' ramean balaki' men ramekononna Alaata'ala,

kada' i kuu mangkaan antokna giigii' tomundo' tia tanaasna surudadu ka' mian men poopapate, ka' antokna mian men nangalakiti kuda, ka' antokna kuda ka' antokna giigii' mian men moola' kabai morio', mian men sianta nipo'ata' ka' mian men nipo'ata'.”

Kasi yaku' nimiile' ayop iya'a, ka' giigii' tomundo' na tano' balaki' tia giigii' surudaduna i raaya'a. Raaya'a nobarimpungmo bo poopapate pootimbangi tia Men nolumakit na kuda bubulak iya'a ka' surudadu-Na.

Mbaka' nirakopmo a ayop iya'a tia minti nabi-nabii men mbaripian nangawawaumo upa kosamba' na aropna ayop iya'a. (Upa kosamba' men ia wawau minti nabi-nabii iya'a a nangakalina mian men nangala oosna ayop iya'a tia giigii' mian men mangkanggi patungna ayop iya'a.) Ayop tia minti nabi-nabii men nirakop iya'a nitibarkonmo tituo' na lalomna apu ayal men mosoya-soya' kaitionna balerang.
Ka' giigii' surudaduna Ia papateimo tia sinangkidi men ua'uar na nganga'-Na men nolumakit na kuda bubulak iya'a. Mbaka' giigii' sapu' nobentengmo nangkaan antokna i raaya'a men nipapatei.
